name: zvideo_dd3d_draw_point_color16
description: zVideo_dd3d::DrawPointColor16 expands one packed 16-bit point color and draws a single immediate D3D point.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo immediate drawing pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4acbd0 validates the zvid_ddd3d.c source file, fastcall pointPos in ECX and packedColor16 in EDX with pointCount as a cleaned stack argument, ret 0x4 cleanup, and no return value.

The reachable contract writes one TL vertex from pointPos, sets rhw from z, expands packedColor16 through the current pixel-pack masks/shifts to 0xffRRGGBB, writes specular 0xff000000, and ignores pointCount while drawing exactly one point.

The function clears cached D3D texture handle state when nonzero, sets cached shade mode to 1 when needed, then calls IDirect3DDevice2::DrawPrimitive through the provider vtable with D3DPT_POINT, D3DVT_TLVERTEX, the temporary TL vertex buffer, vertex count 1, and flags 0.

DrawPrimitive failures call zVideo_dd::ReportError with the recovered zvid_ddd3d.c line 0xa4c. Binary Ninja decompilation has no warning tags; the only direct authored callee is zVideo_dd::ReportError at tier C or better, and Direct3D SetRenderState/DrawPrimitive are SDK provider vtable dependencies.

Native smoke verifies 565 color expansion, one-point vertex/rhw/specular writes, pointCount ignored behavior, render-state cache updates, DrawPrimitive provider arguments, and cache-hit immediate draw behavior.
